mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at 57 degrees with overcast skies near the Verona Public Library. Also, look up to the sky tonight because the International Space Station will be visible for 6 minutes starting at 8:23 PM, rising in the west-northwest over Cross Plains and traveling toward the northeast near Home Depot, peaking at about halfway up the sky.

In local news, officers were dispatched to the 600 block of Hunters Cove Way on September 10th for a burglary in progress. A 19-year-old suspect from Madison was taken into custody with a handgun recovered at the scene, and he is now facing charges for burglary and recklessly endangering safety.

Today you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness. Looking ahead to tomorrow, there is trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Macs. On September 16th, we have live music at Paddy Macs, the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, Pizza and a Pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, and trivia at The Bogey Factory, followed by more live music on September 18th.
On September 10th, Verona police responded to a residential burglary on Hunters Cove Way where a suspect was apprehended and a firearm was recovered from the scene.
Culver's is currently open until 10 PM, however, please be aware that the restaurant is closed today for a remodel.
